mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is causally linked to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signal a contraction in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 270), a monthly increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% rise) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 270 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) is causally linked to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as construction activity and related sectors contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: In a slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 19000), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to weakening industrial activity and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 19000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is causally linked to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real corporate earnings and prompts monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.
